title: Prof. Deepak Dhar Awarded Prestigious 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for Statistical Mechanics
summary: Professor Deepak Dhar (UP) awarded the 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for contributions to statistical mechanics.

blocks.content: Professor Deepak Dhar (UP) awarded the 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for contributions to statistical mechanics.

items: **Awardee:** Prof. Deepak Dhar (from Uttar Pradesh) shares 2026 Dirac Medal with Bernard Derrida, Marc Mézard, and Haim Sompolinsky.
**About Dirac Medal:** Awarded annually on Paul Dirac's birthday (August 8) by ICTP Italy (Prize $5,000).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: ICTP: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics, Trieste, Italy (Instituted 1985).
